observation.visible_scene: A foggy night scene on a paved road, illuminated by streetlights and vehicle headlights. Two large, glowing red lights (likely traffic signals or warning beacons) dominate the upper center background. On the right, a row of red and white reflective bollards lines the edge of a dark hedge. The road surface is visible in the foreground with a crack running through it.
visible_changes: A dark vehicle is visible in the mid-ground, moving from left to right across the scene in the first few seconds (t=0.00 to t=0.13).
As the crossing vehicle moves out of view, a bright pair of white headlights facing the camera becomes prominent in the center-left distance (t=0.16 onwards).
The glare from the oncoming headlights intensifies and remains steady for the rest of the clip, diffused by the fog.
The camera perspective remains static throughout the sequence, with the road crack and bollards maintaining fixed positions relative to the frame.
outside_clip_unknowns: The identity or destination of the vehicle with the bright headlights.
Whether the red lights change state after the clip ends.
The specific location or context of the road (e.g., intersection, construction zone).
uncertain_details: Whether the bright headlights belong to the same vehicle that was crossing or a second vehicle.
The exact distance of the approaching vehicle due to the fog obscuring depth cues.
